capabilities: Lock plugin versions by prefixing manifest.json versions with 9999.
Batch lock or unlock all visible plugins after search or filtering
Snapshot and restore plugin files (main.js, styles.css, manifest.json)
Preview GitHub release notes and compare versions for identified repositories
Export and import lock settings as JSON files in the vault
extras: The README warns that locking directly rewrites other plugins' manifest.json files inside the vault configuration directory and that snapshots store backup copies of plugin assets; the changelog feature makes network requests to GitHub only when enabled.
motivation: The author states many plugins ship breaking changes between versions and built it for users who prefer to stay on a stable, known-good version until ready to migrate.
problem: Obsidian updates community plugins automatically, and breaking changes between versions can disrupt a working setup with no built-in way to stay pinned.

relations.evidence: The changelog feature sends requests to the GitHub Releases API when you click a plugin name

summary: Plugin version pinning tool that freezes selected community plugins by rewriting their manifest.json version so Obsidian treats them as up to date.
